Adds log-GDP size adjustment (+0 to +1.5 pts)

Bayesian Simulation LINEAR BLEND
Run 1 000 Dirichlet-sampled simulations per country and compute CVaR₂₅ from scratch. Cross-section z+sigmoid normalised. Replaces linear pillar blend.

Dirichlet Concentration α 3.00
